title: Digital twin — emotion image map
description: Maps each named emotion to a visible PNG and optional motion JSON. Proof of concept for landscape inhabitants that react to visitor camera input via ml5.
author: Mark Walhimer
note: JSON holds geometry only — no photos inside. PNGs are the visible face per mood.

stack.html: Self-contained pages under sketches/digital-twin/ (p5 + ml5 vendored locally)
stack.ml: ml5.js — face mesh + selfie segmentation (MediaPipe via ml5)
stack.cursor: Cursor IDE — build and iteration environment
stack.runtime: Browser + localhost http.server — camera requires http(s)
